meta.question: can a two-stage (PFT) design close the gap to a plain merge on the cross-preparation test set T2?
meta.data: phase7_prep_ood.py data block, unchanged (formulation B, labels = max, prep_enc dropped, lab-duplicate guard)
meta.scoring: truth = literature max yield per T2 composition; spearman, enrichment@10%, precision@20 from cat_metrics
meta.per_seed_mean_vs_seed_averaged: per_seed_mean = mean of per-seed metrics; seed_averaged = metric of the 5-seed mean prediction
meta.gas_flow_conditions: cannot enter this analysis: the literature file has no condition columns (not possible from the current CSV); checked in code

rules.R_help: per-seed (arm - C1) Spearman >= 0.02 in >= 4/5 seeds; phase7 coded form also reported
rules.R_close: PFT arms C4, C4q, C6: per-seed (arm - C2) Spearman >= 0.02 in >= 4/5 seeds AND paired bootstrap CI of Spearman(arm) - Spearman(C2) lower end > 0
rules.R_beat_merge: same test as R_close for C3, C5, C7; not the R_close verdict

meta.rmse_caveat: lab labels are max-of-~97 measurements, literature labels max-of-~2.2; absolute RMSE across that boundary compares two estimators, not two skill levels; C4q and C7 also change the label scale

diagnostics_stage1_prior.note: C6's T2 prior comes from the same stage-1 model as C4's (asserted identical), so their prior-alone Spearman matches. Its training-row prior range differs: C6 trains on lab + TRAIN_LIT OOF priors, C4 on lab priors only.

sensitivity_S1_lab_label_B_median.label: lab label = B_median (per-(catalyst, temperature) median, max over temperatures); literature labels and T2 truth unchanged. Sensitivity, not the pre-registered result.
